audit_scope: Read-only comparison of comvis_dataset_ready_v1/dataset_prep and comvis_dataset_v2/dataset_prep; no test image viewing or model inspection.

train.csv.detail: penyok01 original plus 37 odd-numbered penyok01 descendants

dataset_comparison.only_augmented_byte_changes: penyok01_aug001.jpg through penyok01_aug073.jpg, odd indices (37 files)

augmentation_reproduction.method: Loaded v2 img/penyok01.jpg in memory, applied each recorded brightness, contrast, and Gaussian blur parameter, JPEG-encoded at quality 95 to BytesIO, then compared SHA-256 with the existing descendant file.

code_risks: Current v2 notebook checks dataset_identity version and raises if the selected root is not v2. However, find_dataset_root recursively sorts Kaggle dataset_prep paths and may select v1 first when both versions are attached; set AQUVIVA_DATASET_ROOT explicitly to the v2 dataset_prep path in that case.

The optional commented Kaggle pip-install example still uses the example slug /kaggle/input/progress2-classical/requirements.txt; replace it with the mounted code dataset path if installation is needed.
code_review_notes: Current builder and generated notebook explicitly describe the retakes, warn that v1/v2 score differences do not prove generalization, and no longer claim the v2 dents remain subtle or are only upper-right.
Kaggle code discovery currently searches parents of /kaggle/input/**/experiment.py, so it can find a code dataset that exposes experiment.py at its mounted root.
